end.summary:
Practised multiplying numbers ending in zeros by multiplying the non-zero parts and counting the zeros.
Rudra answered 6 × 5 = 30 during the lesson.
Rudra repeatedly attached zeros but miscounted them in examples such as 3,000 × 400.
Rounding to the nearest hundred was also discussed; the teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the non-zero-parts-then-count-the-zeros method with Rudra. Rudra used the method of multiplying the digits first and adding zeros, but the zero count remained mixed up in the final examples; this was not corrected after the last time it appeared. At home, practise a few examples such as 6 × 5, then 60 × 500, by writing the non-zero multiplication and counting the zeros separately.
